digest.component_or_area: plan-review & code-review gates; documentation and CLI explain seam
propositions: Authors and contributors lack a concise, author-facing on-ramp guide for writing plans that pass the plan-review gate; existing material is either gate-mechanics or a generated reviewer-facing criterion registry.
The same discoverability gap exists for the code-review gate (LLM-Review + Verified), and AGENTS.md mispoints authors at the criterion registry for the description template.

The rebar explain CLI seam must be extended to route author-guide names (rebar explain plan / rebar explain review) alongside criterion IDs, via a shared registry lookup across library, CLI, and MCP surfaces.

New prose on-ramp docs must remain distinct from the generated registry to preserve the registry as the single source of truth for reviewers, and all new top-level docs must be indexed in docs/README.md to pass the docs-index CI gate.
Unit tests must cover the new explain_guide path across library, CLI, and MCP, validating success for registered guides, unknown-name rejection, and missing-file handling.
